why: The THEMES of the dungeon room kit (tools/dungeon_rooms.py, tools/dungeon_kinds.py, docs/mechanics/DUNGEON_ROOMS.md): the blocks a dungeon's rooms are drawn in and the dressing rules that make a room look like what it is. A dungeon names one in data/dungeons.json (dungeons[].theme). Vanilla blocks only (the pocket is a void dimension: nothing here is checked against the overworld's spawn blocks).
rules: Every block of the hull (wall, floor, ceiling) is OPAQUE. The pocket has skylight at a fixed noon (data/portals.json pocket.generator), so a leaf or glass hull would let daylight into every room; leaves are interior dressing only.
No block that falls (sand, gravel, anvil) and no concrete anywhere (contract C4). No hazard (lava, fire, magma, cactus, berry bush, cobweb, campfire, powder snow, pointed dripstone).

Nothing in the hull or the dressing is on the rift pick's can_break list: the decorative 'ores' of a wall are raw blocks and coal blocks, never ore. The seam's ores sit in a 3-thick slab of unbreakable rock (kind resources), so mining one opens a pocket, never a hole to the void.
Water exists only one block deep, at floor level, over a bed (a deeper pool would need walls under the floor course and would flow into the void).

A dress spec with "lit": true emits light and is skipped in a dark_room. A spec with "level": "full" places obstacles (trunks, columns, piles) and only runs in rooms whose kind is dressed 'full', off a trail kept clear for the player.

mine.name: The old workings
mine.why: Timber sets (posts and a beam every eight blocks, a lantern on a chain), cobbled deepslate, rubble, streaks of raw ore in the walls, and a track laid in the floor with polished blocks and sleepers: NOT rail blocks, which are updated by their neighbours and are not floor.

shapes.why: KIT2 (DUNGEON_ROOMS.md 1a), used by a dungeon with shape_mix true: the mine is rough cavern with a few timbered chambers. Most rooms are noise-carved rock; the safe room and the connectors' stairs stay square (timber needs straight walls); arenas are a stope (oval or cavern); a nest may be a chamber round a rock ring. Puzzles, vaults and kinds with their own geometry keep the box
shapes.secret_block_why: in no mine hull or dressing, so the walk check's count of what the rift pick can break is exactly the seams plus the secrets' faces

soul_sand_valley.name: The valley of souls
soul_sand_valley.why: The soul sand valley: soul soil and soul sand under a roof of blackstone, giant bone fossils (ribs standing, spines lying), basalt ridges, soul torches along the floor, blue lanterns, skulls. NO soul fire (a hazard to the kit) and no bubble columns (the kit refuses a bubble column, and water over soul sand makes one: no stream here has a soul-sand bed). Soul sand slows a walker to 40 percent in vanilla: it is in the floor patches only, in small numbers (a deliberate drag the kit does not model, flagged in the report).
